messages.author: a4934bacd2960724
messages.subject: Barrier model crash
parts:
Hello list,

I am not anymore able to run models with barrier effects since I've updated to the latest version: 
INLA_24.12.11 built 2024-12-11 19:58:26 UTC.

I get this error after some model running time:

inla.mkl: cgeneric_barrier.c:50: inla_cgeneric_barrier: Assertion `!strcasecmp(data->ints[2]->name, "verbose")' failed.
Aborted

I define my barrier effect spde with:

euSD.spde <- inla.barrier.pcmatern(
  mesh = euSD.mesh,
  barrier.triangles = barrier.tri,
  prior.range = c(1000, 0.9),
  prior.sigma = c(10, 0.01)
)

The same model run with the older INLA version.

Any clues on where the  problem is?
Matteo
